title: 3BR Rosemary Beach Home with a Private Pool & Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Treetop Cottage, a 3BR, 2.5BA Rosemary Beach vacation home with a private pool and beach access, free bikes, and 4 minutes from the beach. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• Private Courtyard and Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• 4-Minute Walk to the Beach• 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes• Spacious Balcony with Outdoor Seating• HDTVs in the Living Room and Bedrooms• High-Speed WIFIWelcome to TreeTop Cottage — your serene hideaway nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Newly refreshed and thoughtfully designed, this charming coastal home blends casual elegance with elevated comfort. Light-filled spaces, airy coastal touches, and calming hues invite you to relax and savor every moment. Whether you're lounging by the private pool, strolling to the beach, or unwinding on the breezy balcony, TreeTop Cottage offers the perfect balance of luxury and laid-back 30A living.Ideally located on the west side of Rosemary Beach, TreeTop Cottage is just a short walk to the Gulf's sugar-white sands and emerald waters. Hop on one of the complimentary bikes and explore boutique shops, local eateries, and iconic community spaces. With its prime location and thoughtful amenities, TreeTop Cottage is your dream getaway come to life.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 6)FIRST FLOOR• Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Flat-Screen TV, Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo• Guest Bedroom: 2 Single Beds, Flat-Screen TV, Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo• Master Bedroom: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower, Freestanding Soaking Tub and Double Vanity• Laundry Room with Washer and Dryer• Access to Private Courtyard and PoolSECOND FLOOR• Open Living Room with Ample Seating and Large Flat-Screen TV• SONOS Soundsystem• Gourmet Kitchen with High-End Stainless Steel Appliances, Large Island, and Breakfast Bar• Dining table with seating for 6 and Kitchen island bar seating for 3• Balcony Overlooking Courtyard with Outdoor Dining Space• Half BathroomTDT-075788
